track_titles.review-qbench: Quantum benchmark set of Marino, Buffoni & Zavalnij (2026)

meta.description: Iterated local search with (1,2)-swaps and random kicks, after Andrade, Resende and Werneck (J. Heuristics 2012).
Exact branch-and-bound / clause learning solver from Google OR-Tools, used as an anytime solver with a time limit; certifies optimality when it closes the gap.
Adds a minimum-degree vertex, deletes its neighbourhood, repeats. Deterministic, single pass.
